label: def:witness-12c
title: Pauli witness for ${}^{12}\mathrm{C}$ (exact in $q$)
html:
{}^{12}\mathrm{C} is the frontier of the exact symbolic witness. It is the largest nucleus for which the full symbolic normal form has been computed, and the one whose Pauli factor is smallest in the light-nuclei table. This tracks the rapid dilution of the antisymmetric channel as A grows. Its Pauli witness (Z=6, N=6, A=12) is the exact Gröbner normal form in H_{12}(q) after quotient ideals I_8 + I_9:

  F_{\mathrm{Pauli}}^{(12)} \approx 0.129

The polynomial \mathrm{net}(t) has 479{,}001{,}600 terms before reduction (12!) and collapses to 12 terms in the optimal basis \{\mathbf{1}, \sigma_0, \ldots, \sigma_{10}\} after I_8 + I_9 stripping. The computation is exact in \mathbb{Z}[t, t^{-1}].

The Hoyle state (0_2^+ at 7.65 \text{MeV}) is not captured by the ground-state normal form. It requires a separate witness at an excited braid configuration.
